Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649968. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4649968, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
